question: How many tracks are in the database? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track

question: What is the email address of the customer Leonie Köhler? Return: email.
sql: SELECT Email FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Leonie' AND LastName = 'Köhler'

question: Which country is the customer with id 10 from? Return: country.
sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId = 10

question: What is the job title of the employee Andrew Adams? Return: title.
sql: SELECT Title FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Andrew' AND LastName = 'Adams'

question: How many artists are in the database? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Artist

question: List the titles of all albums by the artist AC/DC. Return: album title.
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: How many tracks are on the album Let There Be Rock? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: Which genre has the most tracks? If several tie, return all of them. Return: genre name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT g.Name, count(*) AS k FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name) SELECT Name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: List the names of the tracks in the playlist named Grunge. Return: track name.
sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: Who is the support representative for the customer Luís Gonçalves? Return: first name, last name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId WHERE c.FirstName = 'Luís' AND c.LastName = 'Gonçalves'

question: Which artist has the most albums? If several tie, return all of them. Return: artist name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT ar.Name, count(*) AS k FROM Artist ar JOIN Album a ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name) SELECT Name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: What is the total amount invoiced to customers who live in Brazil, rounded to two decimals? Return: total.
sql: SELECT round(sum(i.Total), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil'

question: Which employee is the support representative for the most customers? If several tie, return all of them. Return: first name, last name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, count(*) AS k FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName) SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Which employees report directly to Nancy Edwards? Return: first name, last name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

question: Which artist recorded the track Smells Like Teen Spirit? Return: artist name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ar.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId WHERE t.Name = 'Smells Like Teen Spirit'

question: How many tracks use the media type Protected AAC audio file? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name = 'Protected AAC audio file'

question: How many tracks belong to the Jazz genre? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: List the distinct composers of tracks in the Blues genre, ignoring tracks with no composer. Return: composer.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.Composer FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Blues' AND t.Composer IS NOT NULL

question: Which media type is used by the most tracks? If several tie, return all of them. Return: media type name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT m.Name, count(*) AS k FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: What is the average track length in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest integer? Return: average.
sql: SELECT round(avg(Milliseconds)) FROM Track

question: How many invoices have a total greater than 10? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 10

question: Which billing country has the highest total invoiced amount? If several tie, return all of them. Return: country.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT BillingCountry, sum(Total) AS k FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry) SELECT BillingCountry FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Who are the three customers who spent the most in total? Return: first name, last name, total spent, ordered from highest to lowest.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, round(sum(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many tracks cost more than 0.99? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > 0.99

question: How many tracks does each genre have? Return: genre name, track count.
sql: SELECT g.Name, count(*) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

question: What is the total length of all Classical genre tracks in minutes, rounded to one decimal? Return: minutes.
sql: SELECT round(sum(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 1) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Classical'

question: How many customers are there in each country? Return: country, customer count.
sql: SELECT Country, count(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: What is the total revenue from all invoice lines (unit price times quantity), rounded to two decimals? Return: revenue.
sql: SELECT round(sum(UnitPrice * Quantity), 2) FROM InvoiceLine

question: Which playlist contains the most tracks? If several tie, return all of them. Return: playlist name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, count(*) AS k FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name) SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Using the invoice line column named qty, what is the total quantity sold on invoice 1? Return: quantity.
sql: SELECT sum(Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine WHERE InvoiceId = 1
